title: WOMBAT 2026
text:
Requirements for talks
Talk slides and presentations fall under the code of conduct. Talk slides should not contain offensive or sexualized material. If this material is impossible to avoid given the topic (for example text mining of material from hate sites), the existence of this material should be noted both in the abstract and at the start of the talk.

title: WOMBAT 2026
text:
Need help?
If you are being harassed, notice that someone else is being harassed, or have any other concerns, please contact a member of the WOMBAT 2026 code of conduct response team:
